truth_boundary: A registered product profile means DIO knows how to classify, stage, govern, and plan the workflow. It does not mean the product has an implemented executor, external validation, product-market fit, or production authority.
hard_invariants: No product profile may convert model confidence into execution authority.
Every consequential external release retains explicit human or policy authority.
Evidence provenance and claim lineage must survive revision and packaging.
Missing evidence is represented as missing evidence, never silently inferred as satisfied.
Professional, legal, regulatory, accreditation, procurement, investment, and employment decisions remain with authorised humans.
A product may be marketed only when its campaign_enabled flag is true and its claims remain inside the stated proof boundary.
